blocks.content: Let's combine all the components and create a working game of hangman.
Try running the game and see how it works. Make sure you test for:

items: the number of misses (wrong guesses) you can safely make,
the incorrect guesses you've made so far, and
the current status of the game with the dashes and the correctly guessed characters.

blocks.content: This concludes our code for Stage 1 of the project. Now, let's move on to Stage 2 and add further features.
